approval_required_for: A repair broader than the currently approved bounded weight-consumption fix: provide or approve trusted selected-template implementations for IEEE-754 RMSNorm and causal GQA attention, including QK scoring, softmax, PV context, and all required Q/K/V biases, while explicitly authorizing any resulting datapath or topology changes.

If topology changes remain forbidden, provide replacement trusted template sources with the same existing interfaces, topology, pipeline, memory layout, and runtime ABI that already implement the required semantics and consume every declared storage target.
blocked_reasons: accagent/framework/templates/operator_chisel/Norm.scala and its generated-project copy initialize `weightsLoaded` with `RegInit(true.B)`. Consequently `io.weight.ready := !weightsLoaded` is permanently false after reset, so the required 896-word norm stream cannot be accepted by the real RMSNorm DUT port.

The same Norm.scala implementations write `gamma` but never read it in the output datapath. The output is only a signed-width conversion of the input plus `outZeroPoint`. Merely preserving the weight port or recording its tensor hash would not prove DUT consumption, and an adapter is forbidden from implementing replacement RMSNorm behavior.

No authoritative bounded implementation is supplied for the required IEEE-754 RMSNorm operation: fp32 input and fp32 value-preserving gamma storage, epsilon 1e-6, and fp16 output under nearest-even rounding. Inventing integer multiplication, bit mixing, a checksum dependency, or a behavioral floating-point RMSNorm in the wrapper would violate the semantic-harness and numeric-policy rules.

accagent/framework/templates/operator_chisel/Attention.scala and its generated-project copy explicitly implement only a shell that captures `qkvFields(2 * qkvElemsPerBeat + i)` into `vVec` and emits that V vector. Q and K are not used for QK scores, masking, softmax, or PV context. Therefore the required Q/K projection weights and biases cannot be made observably consumed by a wrapper that only instantiates the real selected modules.

Implementing the missing QK, causal GQA mapping, softmax, and PV behavior inside an adapter would be a behavioral substitute and would change the selected attention topology. Implementing it inside Attention.scala would exceed the approved bounded weight-consumption bug fix and violate the prohibition on topology and pipeline changes.

accagent/framework/templates/operator_chisel/Linear.scala and its generated-project copy initialize every weight entry from `defaultWeightTile`, an identity matrix tile. This is the default/identity fallback that the binding requirements explicitly forbid. Removing it is mechanically bounded, but doing so alone does not resolve the non-consuming norm ports or missing attention semantics.

The existing emitted SystemVerilog confirms the optimization consequence: generated/chisel/RMSNorm.sv and VectorNorm.sv contain no weight port, while generated/chisel/AttentionGQA.sv has no Q/K weight-facing computation. These files are read-only, and a standalone elaboration of the unchanged Scala templates would reproduce the same semantic deficiencies.

A manifest with status=pass, dut_consumes_bound_weights=true, complete tensor hashes, and default_or_identity_weight_fallback_disabled=true would therefore make unsupported claims. Weight files and loader routing alone are insufficient evidence under the supplied contract.
output.root_cause: The failure is not only a missing wrapper or manifest. The selected pre-optimization templates violate the required weight-consumption contract: VectorNorm starts with weightsLoaded=true, therefore rejects all norm-weight writes, and its gamma storage is never read; AttentionGQA only collects and emits the V fields and has no QK score, causal softmax, or PV computation, so Q/K projection values do not affect the attention result; Linear initializes weight storage with an identity tile, which is an explicitly forbidden default/identity fallback. The immutable weight-layout artifacts specify storage packing but do not provide an authorized IEEE-754 arithmetic implementation or bounded correction that would make the missing norm and attention weight uses observable while preserving the existing topology, pipeline, ABI, memory layout, and numeric policy.
output.summary: The supplied sources are insufficient for a truthful bounded semantic-harness and complete real-weight-consumption implementation. Wrappers could be fabricated around the current templates, but the resulting manifest could not validly claim that all required tensors are consumed by observable DUT behavior without prohibited datapath or topology changes.
